from tools import list_orders, list_products, get_order, get_product

# Get all Electronics products
electronics_products = list_products(category='Electronics', limit=200, offset=0)
electronics_product_ids = {p['id'] for p in electronics_products}
print("Electronics product IDs:", electronics_product_ids)

# Get all orders in October 2026
oct_orders = list_orders(date_from='2026-10-01', date_to='2026-10-31', limit=5000, offset=0)
print(f"Total orders in Oct 2026: {len(oct_orders)}")

# Filter orders to only those with Electronics products
electronics_orders = [o for o in oct_orders if o['product_id'] in electronics_product_ids]
print(f"Electronics orders in Oct 2026: {len(electronics_orders)}")

# Sort by amount descending and take top 5
sorted_orders = sorted(electronics_orders, key=lambda x: x['amount'], reverse=True)[:5]
print("Top 5 largest Electronics orders in Oct 2026:")
for o in sorted_orders:
